ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: the long discipline
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: A mage or a fighter of the old arts hits a wall in their training, talks it through with someone who has been there, works at it day after day, and comes out the other side a level stronger.

plain.li: Tried the same working nine times today. Nine times it slipped away from me at the same place, like a fish off the hook.
I've stopped getting better. I can feel it. The art used to come easier every week, and now it doesn't come at all.
Everything I know how to do, I can do. Everything past that is a wall, and I keep walking into it.
{OTHER_nameDef} has been where I am now. I should ask how {OTHER_pronoun} got past it. I keep not asking.
[friend] I haven't told anyone how stuck I am. {OTHER_nameDef} would listen, I think, even without understanding a word of the art.
[night] Lay awake going over the forms in my head. In my head they're perfect. In my hands they fall apart.

warm.li: I don't want to burden {OTHER_nameDef} with it. But I think {OTHER_pronoun} would want to know.

blunt.li: Stuck. Same place, every day. Need help.

cheerful.li: Well, I've found the edge of what I can do! Now I just need to find a way over it.

gloomy.li: Maybe this is as far as I go. Some people simply stop, and nobody tells them why.

cold.li: My progress has halted. Someone further along will have an answer. I intend to get it.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has had a face like thunder all week, practicing the same thing over and over. I know that look. I wore it for a year.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has come up against a wall in {PAWN_possessive} art.
{PAWN_nameDef} has stopped getting better at {PAWN_possessive} art, and knows it.

li.label: the long practice
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} grows a level stronger in {PAWN_possessive} art.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said the wall isn't in my hands, it's in my breathing. Practiced with that in mind until supper, and something shifted.
Up before the others to practice. Again after supper. The forms are starting to feel like mine instead of borrowed.
{OTHER_nameDef} told me to stop trying so hard. I didn't understand it until today, when I stopped, and it worked once.
[friend] {OTHER_nameDef} didn't understand half of what I told {OTHER_objective}, and still said the one thing I needed: keep going.
[winter] Practiced out in the cold until my fingers wouldn't bend. Back indoors, with feeling in my fingers again, the working came easier than it has in weeks.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} checks on my practice every evening. I'd hate to disappoint {OTHER_objective}, so I don't skip it.

blunt.li: Practicing. Every day. It's working, slowly.

cheerful.li: It moved. Only a hair, but the wall moved!

gloomy.li: Every day the same forms. Some days I think I'm only getting better at being tired.

cold.li: Twice daily, without exception. Results are small but measurable.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has been out practicing before dawn every day since we talked. I didn't tell {OTHER_objective} to do that. I'm glad of it.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has been practicing {PAWN_possessive} art every day, early and late.
Since talking with {OTHER_nameDef}, {PAWN_nameDef} has thrown {PAWN_objective}self into training.

li.label: the breakthrough
li.waiting: Next: a few quiet days for {PAWN_nameDef} to make the new strength {PAWN_possessive} own.

plain.li: It happened in the middle of an ordinary morning. The working I've failed a hundred times simply went right, as if it had never been hard.
I'm past it. The wall is behind me, and I can't even remember now why it was so high.
Went to tell {OTHER_nameDef} and found I couldn't stop smiling long enough to say it properly.
[friend] I told {OTHER_nameDef} first. It meant nothing to {OTHER_objective}, and {OTHER_pronoun} was happy for me anyway.

warm.li: I owe some of this to {OTHER_nameDef}. Most of it, maybe. I'll tell {OTHER_objective} so when the shaking stops.

cheerful.li: I did it, I really did it, and I want to do it again straight away.

gloomy.li: Past the wall at last. There'll be another one further on. There always is.

cold.li: The barrier is behind me. I'll consolidate before I push further.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came to find me grinning like a child. Didn't need to say a word. I remember the day it happened to me.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has broken through the wall in {PAWN_possessive} art.
{PAWN_nameDef} is a level stronger in {PAWN_possessive} art after weeks of practice.

plain.li: The forms aren't something I'm trying to remember any more. They're simply how I move now.
I've stopped measuring myself against {OTHER_nameDef}. I measure myself against last month, and I win.
Showed {OTHER_nameDef} what I can do now and got a single nod. From {OTHER_nameDef}, that's a speech.
[friend] Sat with {OTHER_nameDef} in the evening and tried to explain what changed. Couldn't. {OTHER_nameDef} said it showed anyway.

warm.li: Whatever comes next in the art, I know I won't face it alone. That's the thing I learned, more than any working.

blunt.li: Stronger. Steadier. Ready for the next wall.

cheerful.li: I'm good at this! I mean properly good, the way I always hoped I would be.

gloomy.li: It's mine now. I suppose I'll have to work just as hard to keep it.

cold.li: The discipline holds. I have what I came here to build.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't need me to watch over the practice any more. I'll miss those cold mornings.
{OTHER_nameDef} has found {OTHER_possessive} own way through the art. It's not my way, and it's better for that.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} came through a long stretch of training stronger, with {OTHER_nameDef} beside {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: [timeout] Weeks of practice, and I'm still on this side of the wall. I'm putting it down for a while before it breaks me.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I'd been saving up the day I broke through to show {OTHER_objective}. I don't know who to show now.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has gone. I'll have to find the way past the wall on my own.
[taken] The art is gone from me. There's nothing left to practice, and I don't know what to do with my hands.
I've let the practice slide. The wall can wait. Maybe I'll be ready for it another year.

warm.li: [timeout] Not yet. {OTHER_nameDef} says some walls take a season. I'll try again in the spring.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The wall won this round! There'll be another round.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I knew it. Some people go further, and some people stop here.

cold.li: [timeout] The method failed. I will find a different one.

fizzleChronicle.li: [otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} died before {PAWN_nameDef} could get past the wall in {PAWN_possessive} art.
{PAWN_nameDef} has put {PAWN_possessive} training aside for now.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was working so hard at the art, out before dawn every day, and was nearly there.
I keep finding {OTHER_nameDef}'s practice things where {OTHER_pronoun} left them. I haven't the heart to move them.

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the same working again and again, until they found where it slipped.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about the wall, and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said [advice].
advice->it was only ever a matter of breathing
advice->every teacher hits one, and every teacher gets past it
advice->to stop trying so hard for a day
advice->the answer is usually in the part that feels easiest
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] practiced side by side until supper, saying very little.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] watched [RECIPIENT_nameDef] go through the forms and pointed out one small thing that changed everything.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat up late talking about how each of them first came to the art.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] admitted to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how stuck [INITIATOR_pronoun] had been, and felt lighter for it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] argued over the right way to [task], and both learned something.

li.label: broke through the wall
li.description: Weeks of the same working failing at the same place, and then this morning it simply went right.

li.label: my art is my own
li.description: The forms aren't something I'm trying to remember any more. They're how I move.

li.label: saw them through it
li.description: I watched them hit the wall and climb over it, and I had a hand in it.
